# Homestead

The Homestead tab of the guidebook: a top-level entry (`WGHomestead`) that gathers the cooking, recipes, farming,
foraging, fishing and hunting guides in one place outside the jobs. The guides themselves live in their own modules;
this module holds only the entry, its landing page and its name. The Chef and Botany pages link across to them.
